name: squat nimbleness
desc: You are uncommonly nimble for your race. You gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You gain proficiency in the Athletics or Acrobatics skill (your choice).
- You have advantage on any Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check you make to escape from being grappled.

advantage.name: Athletics or Acrobatics check to escape from being grappled
